# NamingStorm

> AI-powered brand and domain name generation platform.

## Overview
NamingStorm is an AI platform that generates business names using a structured 3-phase naming methodology (semantic shift, morphemic blending, blank-canvas invention) modeled on real naming-agency practice, combined with a deterministic sound-symbolism phonetic scorer. It produces brand names, phonetic/trademark/domain scores, real .com availability checks, and AI-generated brand stories for startups, e-commerce, and consumer brands.

## Key Features
- AI name generation using a 3-phase methodology (semantic shift, morphemic blending, invented "blank canvas" words)
- Deterministic phonetic scoring based on published sound-symbolism research, independent of the AI's own self-assessment
- Real .com domain availability checks (RDAP) with brandable alternative suggestions when a name is taken
- Preliminary trademark screening (not a legal clearance search)
- AI-generated brand story (tagline, investor pitch, brand voice) per name

## Pricing
- 5 free searches, no account required
- $5 one-time for a 10-search pack
- $12/month Pro subscription for unlimited reports
